integrity: Self-contained proof and exact-integer finite checker; numerical enumeration is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact for the specified symmetric cat automorphism and exponential l1 analytic Fourier weights; maximizers may depend on time. Older equivalent sharp-Fourier-escape formulas cannot be fully ruled out; no nonlinear generalization is asserted.
title: Exact Fibonacci analytic mixing norm of the classical cat map
